feedback.short: Give them at least 40 words: one moment, what you did, and why it matters.
feedback.long: Keep the answer under 2400 characters so it is easy to read.
feedback.filler: Skip the generic opener. Add your own story or a concrete plan.
feedback.repetition: This mostly echoes the prompt or repeats itself. Add your own details.
feedback.specificity: Add two kinds of detail: an object or place, a number, a sequence, or what you did.
feedback.success: Quest complete. Your introduction is ready for the Giver to review.
